text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haah...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(This is the Classic. This is the Satsuki 
Sho. I've watched it countless times. 
...I've studied it dozens of times.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (Even so. Even so—)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What incredible energy! So this is the 
Classic Triple Crown route!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Just like last year, it was a high-level 
battle! Everyone, please give them a round 
of applause!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Excited Youth A
text_block_list.text:
What the heck!? Her strength is completely 
off the charts! What is she even...?! 
...Nghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Excited Youth B
text_block_list.text: The strongest...!

text_block_list.name: Excited Youth B
text_block_list.text:
The strongest! Truly the strongest! The 
one standing before us now is surely the 
'strongest in history' who will rewrite 
everything...!

text_block_list.name: Excited Youth B
text_block_list.text:
"We finally get to witness history in the 
making—the birth of a legend!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Excitement poured in from the stands. And 
the one towards whom those fervent, 
intense gazes were directed wasâ

text_block_list.name: Excited Youth A
text_block_list.text:
...Narita Brian. That sharpness... It was 
only for the final instant, but—

text_block_list.name: Excited Youth A
text_block_list.text:
"In the next Derby, that... will evolve 
even further...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(The next leg of the Classic Triple Crown 
is the Derby. A showdown at the summit... 
open only to Classic-class girls.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"The next Derby will be mine! I'll become 
someone who can surpass that running—!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I want to win...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after the race. Seeing Sakura Laurel 
still buzzing with excitement before the 
live concert, I tended to her and decided 
we should step outside for some fresh air.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... This year's generation is 
insane... And this is only the first race 
of the Classic Triple Crown...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
"I'm on Team Narita Brian! I've got my 
eyes on her this year!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
"Her older sister is super strong too! By 
the next Derby, she's gonna do something 
even crazier!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The expectations placed on Brian-chan are 
burning quite hot, aren't they...!
choice_data_list:
Once you see that run, you'll never forget 
it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm. Indeed—

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Just like with BNW last year, 
the Classic Triple Crown really is 
something incredible.

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text:
Right~! But the Nippon Derby is totally 
different from the Satsuki Sho!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text:
It's the dream stage for everyone involved 
in racing, so to speak... And the hype is 
on a whole other level! It's incredible!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: The Derby...

At that moment, the wind blew. The fresh 
post-spring greenery swayed, and I felt I 
could hear the faint, delicate rustle of 
leaves...
